d: The Temerario replaces the Huracan, and with it goes the naturally aspirated V10. In its place sits a new 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 working with three electric motors, and Lamborghini calls it the most powerful and highest-revving V8 ever fitted to a production car. Combined, the system makes 920hp and 800Nm, enough to take the Temerario from 0-100kmph in 2.7 seconds and on to a top speed of 343kmph.
